# betterado_agent_pools (Data Source)

Use this data source to access information about all Azure DevOps Agent Pools.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `agent_pools` (Attributes List) A list of existing agent pools. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--agent_pools))
- `id` (String) The ID of the data source (timestamp).

<a id="nestedatt--agent_pools"></a>
### Nested Schema for `agent_pools`

Read-Only:

- `auto_provision` (Boolean) Whether the agent pool is automatically provisioned.
- `auto_update` (Boolean) Whether agents in the pool are automatically updated.
- `id` (Number) The ID of the agent pool.
- `name` (String) The name of the agent pool.
- `pool_type` (String) The type of the agent pool (Automation or Deployment).
